title: metadata: a runtime permission-set save accepts a grant on an object that does not exist (200) — the build refuses the same grant (#18202), so a typo silently grants nothing
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWJDYbbtH6dhJNoboN

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: 公开入口 HTTP `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/NAME` 实测一次错误结果）
业务理由: 在 Studio 或用 API 运行时编辑权限集的管理员，把对象名写错（例如短名 `lead` 而不是 `crm_lead`）会得到 200，以为授权成功，实际什么都没授。#18202 正是为这个场景在构建期加了硬失败（「grant is simply lost … Fail loudly at build time」），但运行时保存门没有同样的检查，同一个错误在两条路上一条报错、一条静默。
动手的读者: domain:server 席，元数据保存门对 `permission` 的校验（`packages/metadata-protocol`）：复用 `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 `collectPermissionGrantObjectErrors` 判据（平台对象照放行），对运行时已注册对象集合判 `objects` 的键，未知对象 422 点名。
查重: `permission set grant unknown object runtime save` 121 命中、`permission set objects not defined meta PUT` 51、`collectPermissionGrantObjectErrors` 1（均含已关）；最近邻 #18202（构建期规则本身，已关），没有运行时门的卡。

QA-source: #28981 · access-security.permission-matrix-edit-loop · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/qa_r3_probe2` whose `objects` names `qa_no_such_object` answers 200 (active save), and the same body through `?mode=draft` then publish answers 200 too.
- The grant applies to nothing.
- `defineStack`'s cross-reference validation refuses the same grant at build (`collectPermissionGrantObjectErrors`, `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, #18202): "A grant keyed by an object that isn't declared … silently applies to NOTHING … Fail loudly at build time."

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), stock showcase boot from a scratch copy, as the seeded admin.

## Reproduction
1. As admin: `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/qa_r3_probe2` with an otherwise valid permission-set body whose `objects` map carries a grant keyed `qa_no_such_object` (an object no package registers).
2. **Expected:** 422 naming `objects.qa_no_such_object` as an unknown object, as the build-time rule does.
3. **Actual:** 200, stored and served; the same through draft → publish.
